title: A customized allogenic bone block for alveolar reconstruction quantitated by a 3D matching technique: A case report
authors: Blume O, Back M, Martin K, Windisch P. Clin Case Rep. 2021 Sep;9(9):e04771. doi: 10.1002/ccr3.4771. * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Abstract, verbatim (no separate conclusion section): “After initial resorption, the bone volume showed long -term stability following loading of the implant. Furthermore, 3D matching was a suitable quantification method to analyze the volume development of bone augmentation. 31” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
